public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI had $34B opex on $13.07B revenue in 2025, and its operating margin worsened to -183% in Q2 2026.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI, in 2025, had $34 billion in operating expenses on $13.07 billion in revenue. In Q2 2026, its operating margin worsened to negative 183%.

our_interpretation: The claim contains three financial observations: 2025 operating expenses, 2025 realized revenue and Q2 2026 operating margin.
The target-period envelope covers 2025 and Q2 2026; each component must be checked only against its own stated period.
Operating margin means operating income divided by realized revenue, not net income or cash burn.
'Worsened' can be tested against the preceding quarter and the stated 2025 baseline.
The figures are treated as press-reported estimates, without assuming GAAP or another unstated accounting standard.
'Operating expenses' may mean all operating costs, including cost of revenue, or the narrower expense category excluding it. I do not silently equate these.
Rounded financial inputs can substantiate an approximate margin but may not establish the exact stated whole-percentage figure.
criteria.support_condition: Matching financial records establish the stated 2025 revenue and operating-expense figures and a Q2 2026 operating margin consistent with negative 183% at the reported precision, with deterioration on a consistent basis.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish materially different annual figures or a Q2 margin inconsistent with the stated value and deterioration. A different expense classification or insufficient input precision alone is not a contradiction.
